question: Which among the following is the famous harvest festival of Meghalaya, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nongkrem festival**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nongkrem festival:** It is a significant harvest festival celebrated by the** Khasi tribe in Meghalaya.**
 
• The festival is a thanksgiving ceremony to **God Almighty for the good harvest and prosperity of the people.**
 
• The festival involves the performance of** traditional music, dance, and rituals, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Khasi tribe.**
 
• The dance performed during the Nongkrem festival, known as **'Ka Shad Nongkrem,' is a major highlight of the festival.**
 
• The** festival generally lasts for five days, and people participate in the festivities dressed in their traditional attires.**
 
• Nongkrem festival is not just an occasion of merriment but also strengthens the social fabric of the Khasi community.
